import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.games import make_game
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path = Path('results/training/qwen38_primary_grpo_validation_completion.json')
assert not path.exists()
root = Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-primary-grpo-validation-v1')
launch_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_primary_grpo_validation.json')
launch = json.loads(launch_path.read_text())
assert launch['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
source = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_primary_grpo_validate/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py')
assert file_sha256(source) == launch['source_sha256']
core = next(n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text())) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='write_text' and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Constant))
assert (root / 'evaluate_core.py').read_text() == core
work = root / 'qwen3.8-27b-grpo'
runtime = json.loads((work / 'runtime.json').read_text())
pair = json.loads((root / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
cohorts = {}
for game in ('dice', 'cards'):
    raw = work / 'results/raw' / game / 'qwen3.8-27b-grpo.jsonl'
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()] if raw.exists() else []
    assert [r['seed'] for r in rows] == list(range(80000, 80000 + len(rows)))
    for row in rows:
        canonical = make_game(game).episode(row['seed'])
        assert row['value'] == canonical.value and len(row['rounds']) == 6
        assert [r['reveal'] for r in row['rounds']] == canonical.reveals
        cfg = row['provenance']['config']
        assert cfg['eval_batch_size'] == 1 and cfg['seed'] == 0
        assert cfg['adapter_sha256'] == file_sha256(Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-round3-training-v5/lora_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors'))
        assert cfg['revision'] == '8aa5f05d26b7205477066e1449e0af13f762a299'
    cohorts[game] = {'episodes': len(rows), 'complete': len(rows) == 100, 'canonical_games_verified': True,
                     'file': str(raw), 'sha256': file_sha256(raw) if raw.exists() else None}
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain saved primary GRPO validation, including any bounded timeout'}, runtime['model_revision']),
    'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'complete' if all(c['complete'] for c in cohorts.values()) else 'partial_validation_retained',
    'runtime': runtime, 'pair_runtime': pair, 'cohorts': cohorts,
    'downloaded_files': {str(p): {'sha256': file_sha256(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size} for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
    'scope': 'Validation split only. Any incomplete game remains unscored; no held-out aggregate opened.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
session = next(s for s in ledger['sessions'] if s['kernel'] == launch['metadata']['id'] and s['version'] == 1)
session.update(status=record['status'], hours=runtime['wall_seconds']/3600, script_wall_seconds=runtime['wall_seconds'],
    script_started_at=runtime['execution_started_at'], script_finished_at=runtime.get('execution_finished_at'), result_file=str(work/'runtime.json'),
    hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.')
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Retained primary GRPO', {g: c['episodes'] for g,c in cohorts.items()}, flush=True)

runtime.error: TimeoutError: Registered training wall budget exhausted
